Caught in cycles of rebirth, she relived crushed hopes time after time, forced into becoming Li Wang's plaything.#r Guided by Pu Yufeng, [player] destroyed Li Wang's true form with a century-old pact token, freeing Su Xiu. The king kept his oath by crushing the mighty Kingdom of Burningland and forcing them to retract their demands.#r Her homecoming joy lasted barely a month. Funavi saw Helton transformed—king and peasant alike consumed by a feverish, war-mad atmosphere. The nation became a chariot charging toward revenge. Her grandfather Tennant, disgraced for past defeats, was stripped of his title and made a palace guard. Her father now consulted only mysterious sorcerers, ignoring his court. Funavi's warnings changed nothing. War consumed the White River, mountains, and all who opposed Helton's banners.#r When news came of Helton's conquest of Kingdom of Burningland and the Edgarad massacre, Funavi abandoned hope in her father. She fled to Springland, the last free kingdom. There, she met The Grow, deity of HP, and learned the truth: Thorn King had bargained with extra-dimensional demons—endless HP sacrifices for a curse that "only Helton can kill Helton."#r The Thorn King's forces fell at Lorraine. Springland honored her by naming its fall maples Funavi's Autumn.#r Both survived. The Mana storm hurled Sharp Stake Fort's inhabitants beyond the Veil, where the Thorn King enslaved Funavi's mind. After centuries adrift, he charted a course to Eulogize and Dispatched Funavi and Blighting Knight ahead to ready his forces. Guided by The Grow, [player] awakened the true Funavi, who then defeated the reborn Thorn King, ending the ancient tragedy.#r Mission complete, Funavi stayed by [player]'s side to Charge Charge in gratitude. Child of autumn and The Grow, she'll one day return to her namesake mountain, close her eyes beneath crimson maples, and find peace at last.
